data.name: Chakra Initiate
data.description: You have an extra wellspring of kundalini energy that you can use to open your chakras. You gain a pool that holds 3 points of serpent-fire ki, which you can use only to open or maintain chakras. These serpent-fire ki points are replenished at the same time you replenish the points in your regular ki pool.
prerequisites: PRETEXT:Ability to awaken the root chakra.
